name: base
description: The base catalog: everything every renderer draws. The language's own elements (control flow, async boundaries, the Blok element, the declarations, text), the html components, the structure and run parts a host supplies, the scene and the logo shapes. A renderer speaks it whole, in the contexts it draws; functions and effects are in vocabulary.json.

components.name: Blok
components.description: Every blok is one: it says its kind (what it reads, where it may be mounted), its context (what host draws it), the catalog it is written for and the host's chrome. A panel lays its children out as a fragment does; a scene holds one Scene or Space, a logo one Logo, besides its declarations.

props.description: What the blok is: what it reads, and where it may be mounted.
What draws it: a panel (a flat rectangle the host lays out), a scene (a 3D view) or a logo (an SVG drawing).
The catalog it is written for (the address it is published at, or the name of one registered in the organization); the base catalog when left out.

What the host draws around the blok of its own (panel and scene): `auto` (the default) adds what the blok does not place (the time slider, the open ask, the rest of the argument form, its buttons); `none` adds nothing, the blok places what it wants.

components.name: local
components.description: Declares a local: form state controls write through bind, read bare in its parent's subtree; inside a foreach, one per item. It comes first among its parent's children and draws nothing.

props.description: The name the subtree reads it by, bare (never a reserved root).
The value it starts with: a literal.
Its port kind (INT, FLOAT, STRING, BOOL, ENUM, DATE, QUANTITY, LIST, DICT, MODEL, STRUCTURE, ...) or ANY; left out, inferred from its default and its uses.
A LIST, DICT or MODEL local's child ports, as ports.
What a form shows it as.
Remember the last input on this device (never on a server).
Take the port of an action's argument: self.<action>.<arg> or deps.<key>.<action>.<arg>, resolved where the blok is mounted.

props.description: The service it runs on, by key (mikro).
One GraphQL query operation, never a mutation.
Also re-run every this many seconds.
The list field of its result new pages append to (queries.<name>.fetch_more(...)).

props.description: The service it runs on, by key.
Keep the last this many payloads as a list; the latest only when left out.
A declared query to replay from while travelling.

props.description: The text: a literal, or an expression whose value is shown as text.

components.name: case
components.description: One branch of a `match`: its children render when the matched value is `is`.

props.description: The literal this case matches, or a list of them.

components.name: default
components.description: The branch of a `match` that renders when no `case` matches.

components.name: else
components.description: A branch of its `if`: an else-if with `when`, the default without. Only the last `else` may go without `when`.

props.description: The else-if condition; the default branch when absent.

components.name: error
components.description: What a `suspense` shows when a read inside it failed; the error is readable as `error` (`error.message`).

components.name: fallback
components.description: What a `suspense` shows while a read inside it is pending.

components.name: foreach
components.description: Renders its children once per item, the item bound to `let`; each item's subtree takes its ids from `key`, or from its position without one.

props.description: A stable key per item (`key={p.id}`): what an item's ids, kept values and diffs follow. Left out, items are keyed by their position (<id>@#<n>), which suits scalars only.
The loop variable: a plain name, read bare inside.

components.name: fragment
components.description: Groups children without rendering anything of its own.

components.name: if
components.description: Renders its children (the then-branch) when `when` holds; its trailing `else` children are the else-if and default branches. Only the active branch is rendered and read.

components.name: match
components.description: Renders the first `case` whose `is` equals `value`, else its `default`.

components.name: suspense
components.description: A boundary: while any read inside is pending it shows its `fallback`, when one failed its `error` (with the error as `error`); stale values render, dimmed. The nearest boundary catches.

event.description: The structure reference picked, or null when cleared.

props.description: The GraphQL query that lists the candidates, run on the `ward` service: one `query` operation, never a mutation. It selects a list aliased `options` with `value` (the id), `label` and optionally `description`, and may declare: $search: String (what the user typed), $values: [ID!] (ids to resolve), $limit: Int and $offset: Int (a page), $requires (the constraints of the action input being filled). Any other variable is read from `variables`, else from the data path of the same name; a structure held there is passed as its id. A nullable one narrows the list while it has a value and the user may lift it; the picker waits for one declared non-null. Without a query the module that owns the structure answers.
Values for the variables `query` declares beyond the ones the picker supplies.
The service that runs `query`, by its key, e.g. "mikro".
